data: Does the accuracy of the proposed method remain consistently higher than that of GloVe?

The Proposed line is consistently above the GloVe line across all dimensions. This indicates that the accuracy of the proposed method remains higher than that of GloVe throughout the range of dimensions shown in the graph. Therefore, the answer is yes, the accuracy of the proposed method remains consistently higher than that of GloVe.
